pr.title: Stop Git's background maintenance from racing the test fixtures' copies
pr.head: a35a582cbe6beb2949b34a6fbcd4fa40dae5cd0d

summary: The test suite builds temporary Git repositories once and copies them for individual tests. A detached Git maintenance process can outlive the build and remove a lock file while a copy is in progress, causing an unrelated test to fail during setup.

This change disables automatic maintenance and garbage collection through Git command-scope environment configuration before the suite starts its workers. The settings follow child processes and take precedence over repository configuration. Production behavior is unchanged.

cards.title: Validation
cards.html:
• The configured gate and exact-head CI passed, including 263 hook tests.
  • All 25 focused fixture and summary-publication tests passed.
  • Both new regressions reject the base configuration in a disposable copy.
  • The timing-dependent race itself was not forced; the tests verify the effective Git settings that prevent background maintenance.

groups.title: Keep copied fixtures stable
groups.kicker: Disable background mutation before any worker builds a Git fixture
intro: A fixture is a prepared directory that several tests copy instead of rebuilding. The suite now supplies maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0 using GIT_CONFIG_COUNT and its key/value pairs. These settings are read by real Git subprocesses, including those with a separate repository configuration.

The two regressions check the external Git boundary: a copied fixture sees both disabled settings, and a repository that enables maintenance still sees the command-scope override. They fail against the base suite initialization, so they catch losing the override or moving it to a weaker configuration scope.

files.note: Set inherited Git configuration before discovery and test workers can create fixtures.

checks.text: Traced worker launch and explicit subprocess environments: they retain os.environ, so both command-scope settings reach Git. No caller resets GIT_CONFIG_COUNT.

files.note: Exercise effective Git configuration and repository-override resistance through a real copied fixture.

checks.text: The head passes both tests. With the base tests/__init__.py in a disposable copy, the default-setting test errors and the repository-precedence test fails.
